review_candidates.title: (Junior) International Sales and Business Development - CEE
review_candidates.description: (Junior) International Sales and Business Development – CEE Build your own legacy and learn directly from people who mastered the game For one of the companies in our group, Frigo Pact, we are looking for ambitious people who get excited about sales, international business and closing deals, and who want the opportunity to build something of their own. We are growing an international refrigerant consultancy and sales company across Europe, the Middle East and Asia, and we want people who are motivated by the chance to grow with it and make a real impact along the way. Frigo Pact is a start-up with big ambitions and a lot still to build, which is exactly what makes this opportunity so exciting. The conversation you start today could become a major client relationship. The market you begin exploring could become yours to develop. The ideas and opportunities you create can directly shape where the company goes next, and because we are building this together, your ideas genuinely matter. We want to build something fun, dynamic and seriously cool: an international consultancy and sales company with strong positions in its own markets, a great client base and offices in different parts of the world. Joining now means helping to shape that business from an early stage, building something of your own and creating a legacy you can genuinely be proud of. What makes this opportunity stand out is that you do not have to figure it all out yourself. You will work directly with senior professionals who each bring more than 10 years of experience building businesses, opening markets, winning clients and negotiating international deals. We have already learned many of the lessons that normally take years to discover, and we can put that experience behind you while giving you the freedom to develop your own way of doing business. Bring the hunger, energy and determination, and we will give you the knowledge, guidance and support to help you build something amazing. WHAT YOU WILL DO Research international markets and spot companies with real commercial potential. Start conversations through calls, email and LinkedIn, and turn those first conversations into real opportunities. Understand what potential clients need and qualify opportunities together with the senior trading team. Build relationships through thoughtful follow-up, keep your promises and become someone clients trust. Work closely with senior traders and learn how negotiations and live deals unfold. As you prove yourself, take increasing ownership of clients, deals and your own market. WHERE THIS CAN GO The conversations you start can become the foundation of your own market. As you prove yourself, you can grow into managing clients and negotiating deals, becoming the person clients call when they want business to happen. For exceptional performers, that can grow into leading a team, helping open a new office or working towards partnership or equity. These opportunities are considered individually, based on your contribution and the growth of the business. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for ambitious people who want to turn that ambition into something real. You might be studying, recently graduated or ready for a new direction. Sales experience is welcome, but your curiosity, drive and willingness to learn matter more. YOU WANT TO BUILD SOMETHING You are excited by the idea of winning a client's trust, creating opportunities and developing a market you can eventually call your own. You are ready to make the first move and start conversations that can grow into real business. YOU TAKE OWNERSHIP You follow through. You keep going when the first attempt leads nowhere, learn from the response and try again. You want responsibility, and you are ready to earn it. YOU WANT TO BECOME EXCEPTIONAL You welcome honest feedback from people who have done this for years, use it to improve and take pride in getting better. You want to become the best at what you do. YOU SPEAK DIFFERENT LANGUAGES You have a good command of English, and speaking one or more Central & Eastern European languages (preferably Polish, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Romanian and/or Bulgarian) is a strong advantage. You are open to learning new languages and enjoy connecting with people from different cultures. WHAT WE OFFER A package that rewards the business you help create, including up to €3,000 per lead when it results in a signed transaction. Base salary, commission and qualifying conditions are agreed individually, depending on your arrangement and location. Direct coaching from senior people who each bring more than 10 years of experience. You can reach them whenever you need guidance on a conversation, opportunity or deal. Flexible working arrangements: remote, hybrid, or office-based, with the option to start full-time, part-time, alongside your studies or current job, or on a self-employed basis, and grow your role as you achieve results. Real exposure to international clients and commercial opportunities, growing into negotiations, live deals and international travel as your responsibilities develop. The opportunity to build your own market, with the potential to grow into leadership, partnership or equity for exceptional performers. WHAT COULD YOU BUILD HERE? Tell us what drives you, what you want to build and why Frigo Pact caught your attention. Apply using the LinkedIn application button or email admin@fpconsulting.nl.

review_candidates.title: (Assistant) Application Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview: We are seeking a highly motivated and technically competent (Assistant) Application Engineer specializing in Diesel Power Generators to support data centre and power generation projects in Malaysia. This role combines application engineering, quality assurance, and hands-on testing and commissioning responsibilities. The successful candidate will play a critical role across the product lifecycle — from design validation and factory testing to on-site commissioning and final acceptance. The position requires strong technical expertise in diesel power generation systems, rigorous testing methodologies, and compliance with industry standards. The engineer will collaborate closely with internal teams, factories, vendors, and clients to ensure systems meet performance, safety, reliability, and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities: 1.Application Engineering and Product Support Provide technical application support for diesel power generator systems in data centre and industrial projects. Review customer specifications and Single Line Diagrams (SLD) to ensure technical alignment and compliance. Support generator sizing and configuration based on project load profiles and operational requirements. Assist in design evaluation and recommend improvements for performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. Support cross-functional teams in resolving technical and performance-related issues. Liaise with factories and vendors to ensure alignment on specifications, testing requirements, and delivery schedules. 2.Testing and Commissioning (FAT, SAT, IST) Perform and manage Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and Integrated Systems Tests (IST). Develop, review, and execute comprehensive test plans, procedures, and protocols aligned with customer and project requirements. Conduct hands-on testing of diesel generators, electrical systems, control systems, and associated power equipment. Verify load acceptance performance in accordance with project specifications. Perform transient response testing to validate system stability and dynamic performance. Validate generator protection functions and settings in accordance with applicable standards. Conduct synchronisation and load sharing verification for parallel generator operations. Ensure all systems comply with relevant industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, NEC) and regulatory requirements. Provide on-site technical support during genset installation, testing, and commissioning phases. Coordinate commissioning activities with project teams to meet overall project milestones and schedules. 3.Quality Control and Validation Develop and implement structured testing methodologies to validate performance, durability, and reliability. Identify, document, and report defects or non-conformities discovered during testing. Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control system issues efficiently. Ensure full technical compliance with project specifications and regulatory requirements prior to system handover. Ensure products are thoroughly tested before manufacturing release or customer deployment. 4.Documentation and Reporting Maintain accurate records of test results, defect logs, corrective actions, and compliance documentation. Prepare detailed test reports, commissioning reports, and technical documentation. Review and contribute to commissioning plans, operation manuals, and project documentation. Communicate findings clearly to internal teams, clients, and stakeholders. 5.Continuous Improvement Contribute to improving testing processes, commissioning practices, and quality control systems. Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry best practices in diesel power generation and data centre infrastructure. Support implementation of test automation tools and product lifecycle management systems where applicable. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). Proven experience in testing, quality control, or applications engineering, preferably with diesel power generators or similar systems. Strong knowledge of diesel engine operations, performance metrics, and troubleshooting methods. Proficiency in creating test plans, executing tests, and diagnosing technical issues. Excellent problem-solving abilities and collaboration skills. Familiarity with generator control systems, protection principles, and power system integration. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in data centre or mission-critical power infrastructure projects Exposure to ISO 8528 standards for generator performance and testing CIDB certification
